profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Capital One | Master of Science in Computer Science
profile.summary: Dynamic and results-driven engineer with expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep learning. Leveraging academic prowess, business acumen, and hands-on software engineering experience to drive innovation and achieve strategic business goals. Skilled in optimizing algorithms and developing cutting-edge solutions. Additionally, experienced in human-computer interaction, contributing insights and expertise to enhance user experiences and interface design. Proficient in full-stack development and experienced in DevOps practices, utilizing a range of tools to streamline development processes and ensure efficient deployment and operation of software solutions. Passionate about leveraging technology to create impactful results and improve the interaction between humans and machines.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated ChatGPT (LLM) to help artists craft branded music track descriptions for Gala's self-minting platform, ensuring consistency and enhancing user experience.

• Delivered a GenAI pipeline modulating user voices into characters like orcs, goblins, & wizards, running models on the user's GPU via their client, enhancing UX & game immersion.

• Spearheaded the development of a Voice Conversion feature for an MMO in Unity, significantly enhancing user experience and game immersion.

• Led cloud-based, distributed training using Docker, EC2s, AMI, PyTorch, & Onnx to optimize generative deep learning models (GAN, Vocoder, & transformer) reducing the cost of training by 33%.

• Contributed to technical excellence through developing, training, and fine-tuning deep learning models.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the delivery of version 1 of Gala's Music Webapp within a 4 month timeframe, significantly ahead of the 1-1.5 year timeframe typical at my previous teams.

• Managed diverse responsibilities including AWS services, full-stack development, inter-team coordination, mentored engineers, and preparation for a red team penetration test.

• Prioritized empathy, realistic deadlines, and fostered collaboration between C-level personnel, product teams, and engineering, resulting in the highest team velocity at Gala.

• Co-architected Gala Music Live, emphasizing emerging talent and enhancing Gala's return on investment.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as a dynamic Full Stack Engineer in a high-velocity environment, adapting to evolving requirements and challenges.

• Spearheaded a strategic stack restructuring initiative, transitioning from Nuxt2 to Nuxt3 to address ongoing deprecation issues, ensure tech currency, and future-proof the stack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the Sign API Team in converting the monolith into a series of standalone microservices that were platform-agnostic, leveraging Kubernetes, Terraform, and Docker.

• Provided valuable contributions to Documentation & Deployment team, creating documents for onboarding, releases, and Swagger API documentation.

• Led the transition of Orchestrate product to platform-agnostic model, initiating frontend rewrite for improved scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Full-Stack Development · REST APIs · Swagger API · Kubernetes · Terraform · Java · C# · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Excelled as a Full Stack Developer in a high-velocity environment, navigating evolving requirements and challenges.

• Mentored junior developers, focusing on targeted areas of growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · React.js · Ruby on Rails · Material UI · Mentoring

positions.title: Co-Owner / CMO / Web Developer
positions.description: Skills: Team Leadership · Web Development · React.js · Node.js · WordPress · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Business Development · Marketing Strategy · Martial Arts Instruction · Acupuncture · Herbology · Group Fitness · Personal Training · Corrective Exercise
